svg.title: Where GPTBot can be stopped, and how to see it
svg.desc: A table of four layers. robots.txt: read the file. CDN: open the AI crawler settings. Firewall or plugin: read the rule list. Server: compare a normal request with one that sends the GPTBot user-agent.

g.text: Where GPTBot can be stopped, and how to see it
Open /robots.txt. Look for a rule that names GPTBot, or a blanket Disallow under *.
Open the AI crawler settings of your CDN account; check whether GPTBot is set to block.
Read the rule list for user-agent matches, or "block bots" and "block AI" switches.
Request a page twice, with and without the GPTBot user-agent, and compare status codes.
Not tested by the free check

Layers 2 to 4 answer a crawler with an error code even when robots.txt allows it.
